description: This Java class 'OfbizUrlBuilder' constructs URLs within the OFBiz framework, providing methods to build full URLs, host parts, and path parts based on configuration, request, and website properties.

classes.name: OfbizUrlBuilder
classes.description: A utility class for constructing URLs within the OFBiz web application framework, supporting full URL, host, and path building based on configuration and request context.

methods.name: from (HttpServletRequest request)
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an OfbizUrlBuilder instance based on the current HTTP request, caching it in request attributes.

methods.name: from (WebappInfo webAppInfo, Delegator delegator)
methods.description: Creates an OfbizUrlBuilder instance using web application info and delegator, suitable for scheduled jobs or non-request contexts.

methods.name: buildFullUrl
methods.description: Constructs a complete URL including scheme, host, servlet path, and resource, returning true if HTTPS is used.

methods.name: buildHostPart
methods.description: Builds the URL scheme and host part, considering security settings and request map configurations.

methods.name: buildPathPart
methods.description: Builds the URL path including servlet path and resource, without scheme or host.
